targets.name: erdos_7_odd_covering
targets.title: Erdős #7: Odd covering systems
targets.summary: Prove or disprove whether a finite covering system of Z exists with all moduli odd, distinct, and > 1.
targets.approach: No fixed approach. Prove Spec.Statement (as proved) or its negation (as disproved) in Lean 4.

targets.name: lonely_runner_11
targets.title: Lonely Runner (11 runners)
targets.summary: Prove or disprove the Lonely Runner Conjecture for 11 runners (10 non-zero integer speeds).
targets.approach: No fixed approach. Prove Spec.Statement (as proved) or its negation (as disproved) in Lean 4.

targets.name: erdos_gyarfas
targets.title: Erdős-Gyárfás cycle conjecture
targets.summary: Prove or disprove that every finite simple graph with minimum degree >= 3 has a cycle of length 2^k.
targets.approach: No fixed approach. Prove Spec.Statement (as proved) or its negation (as disproved) in Lean 4.

targets.name: union_closed_sets
targets.title: Frankl union-closed sets
targets.summary: Prove or disprove that every non-trivial finite union-closed family has an element in at least half its sets.
targets.approach: No fixed approach. Prove Spec.Statement (as proved) or its negation (as disproved) in Lean 4.

targets.name: erdos_straus
targets.title: Erdős-Straus 4/n conjecture
targets.summary: Prove or disprove that 4/n = 1/x + 1/y + 1/z has positive integer solutions for every n >= 2.
targets.approach: No fixed approach. Prove Spec.Statement (as proved) or its negation (as disproved) in Lean 4.

targets.name: herzog_schonheim
targets.title: Herzog-Schönheim coset partition
targets.summary: Prove or disprove that any finite partition of a group into >= 2 subgroup cosets repeats some subgroup index.
targets.approach: No fixed approach. Prove Spec.Statement (as proved) or its negation (as disproved) in Lean 4.

targets.name: ramsey_5_6
targets.title: Ramsey lower bound R(5, 6)
targets.summary: Exhibit a larger K_5-free, 6-independent-set-free graph on N vertices to raise the verified lower bound for R(5, 6).
targets.approach: No fixed approach. Any kernel-verified Lean 4 witness strictly beating the current bound.

targets.name: schur_6
targets.title: Schur lower bound S(6)
targets.summary: Exhibit a 6-coloring of {1..N} with no monochromatic x + y = z to raise the verified lower bound for S(6).
targets.approach: No fixed approach. Any kernel-verified Lean 4 witness strictly beating the current bound.

targets.name: cap_set_8
targets.title: Cap set lower bound in F_3^8
targets.summary: Exhibit a larger 3-AP-free subset of F_3^8 to raise the verified cap set lower bound toward and past 512.
targets.approach: No fixed approach. Any kernel-verified Lean 4 witness strictly beating the current bound.

targets.name: vdw_3_5
targets.title: van der Waerden lower bound W(3, 5)
targets.summary: Exhibit a 3-coloring of {0..N-1} with no monochromatic 5-term arithmetic progression to raise W(3, 5).
targets.approach: No fixed approach. Any kernel-verified Lean 4 witness strictly beating the current bound.

targets.name: erdos_7_density_ge_one
targets.title: Lemma: Covering reciprocal sum >= 1
targets.summary: In any finite covering system of Z, the sum of reciprocals 1/m_i of the moduli is at least 1.
targets.approach: No fixed approach. Any kernel-verified Lean 4 proof of this blueprint helper lemma.

targets.name: erdos_7_lcm_reduction
targets.title: Lemma: Covering reduces modulo LCM
targets.summary: A finite congruence family covers all of Z iff it covers every residue modulo the LCM of its moduli.
targets.approach: No fixed approach. Any kernel-verified Lean 4 proof of this blueprint helper lemma.

targets.name: lonely_runner_11_gcd_one
targets.title: Lemma: Reduce speeds to gcd = 1
targets.summary: If the 11-runner conjecture holds for coprime non-zero integer speeds, it holds for all non-zero integer speeds.
targets.approach: No fixed approach. Any kernel-verified Lean 4 proof of this blueprint helper lemma.

targets.name: erdos_gyarfas_min_deg_three
targets.title: Lemma: Reduce to minimal degree >= 3 subgraph
targets.summary: Any finite graph with minimum degree >= 3 contains an inclusion-minimal subgraph with minimum degree >= 3.
targets.approach: No fixed approach. Any kernel-verified Lean 4 proof of this blueprint helper lemma.

targets.name: union_closed_singleton
targets.title: Lemma: Singleton set satisfies Frankl
targets.summary: If a finite union-closed family contains a 1-element set {x}, then x belongs to at least half the sets.
targets.approach: No fixed approach. Any kernel-verified Lean 4 proof of this blueprint helper lemma.

targets.name: union_closed_pair
targets.title: Lemma: 2-element set satisfies Frankl
targets.summary: If a finite union-closed family contains a 2-element set {x, y}, then x or y belongs to at least half the sets.
targets.approach: No fixed approach. Any kernel-verified Lean 4 proof of this blueprint helper lemma.

targets.name: erdos_straus_even
targets.title: Lemma: Erdős-Straus for all even n >= 2
targets.summary: For every even integer n >= 2, 4/n can be written as 1/x + 1/y + 1/z with positive integers x, y, z.
targets.approach: No fixed approach. Any kernel-verified Lean 4 proof of this blueprint helper lemma.

targets.name: erdos_straus_mod_4_eq_3
targets.title: Lemma: Erdős-Straus for n = 3 (mod 4)
targets.summary: For every integer n >= 2 with n % 4 = 3, 4/n can be written as 1/x + 1/y + 1/z with positive integers x, y, z.
targets.approach: No fixed approach. Any kernel-verified Lean 4 proof of this blueprint helper lemma.

targets.name: herzog_schonheim_index_sum
targets.title: Lemma: Coset partition index reciprocals sum to 1
targets.summary: In a finite partition of a group into left cosets of finite-index subgroups, the reciprocal indices sum to 1.
targets.approach: No fixed approach. Any kernel-verified Lean 4 proof of this blueprint helper lemma.

targets.name: cap_set_product_lemma
targets.title: Lemma: Product of cap sets is a cap set
targets.summary: The Cartesian product of two 3-AP-free subsets in F_3^a and F_3^b is a 3-AP-free subset in F_3^(a+b).
targets.approach: No fixed approach. Any kernel-verified Lean 4 proof of this blueprint helper lemma.
